title: Urological Supply Program Accessory Allowance Schedule
content:
Accessory allowances of the Urological Supply Program: the monthly units and fee-schedule amount of each accessory item, for all six catheter programs. A program with an allowance of 0 has no such accessory.

## Lubricant

The lubricant code is the code of separately billable lubricant, or none. The monthly limit is the lubricant units allowed per month (0 when none); the fee is the fee-schedule amount per lubricant unit (0.00 when none).

| Program | Lubricant code | Units per month | Fee per unit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | A4332 | 200 | 0.13 |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | A4332 | 200 | 0.13 |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | none | 0 | 0.00 |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | none | 0 | 0.00 |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | none | 0 | 0.00 |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | none | 0 | 0.00 |

## Trays, bags and adhesive remover

Insertion trays (A4314), bedside drainage bags (A4357), leg bags (A4358) and adhesive remover (A4455, per ounce): units allowed per month and the fee-schedule amount per unit. Trays and adhesive remover show 0 and 0.00 when none.

| Program | Insertion trays per month | Tray fee (USD) | Bedside bags per month | Bedside bag fee (USD) | Leg bags per month | Leg bag fee (USD) | Adhesive remover units per month | Remover fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | 1 | 9.82 | 2 | 11.48 | 4 | 9.85 | 0 | 0.00 |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | 1 | 9.82 | 2 | 11.48 | 4 | 9.85 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | 0 | 0.00 | 2 | 11.48 | 4 | 9.85 | 3 | 2.38 |

## Accessories by program, read across

- Straight Intermittent and Coudé Tip: lubricant A4332, up to 200 units a month at 0.13 USD a unit; no trays, bags or remover.
- Closed-System: no separately billable accessory of any kind.
- Indwelling Foley and All-Silicone: 1 insertion tray at 9.82 USD, 2 bedside bags at 11.48 USD and 4 leg bags at 9.85 USD a month; no lubricant or remover.
- Male External: 2 bedside bags at 11.48 USD, 4 leg bags at 9.85 USD and 3 units of adhesive remover at 2.38 USD a month; no lubricant or trays.
